#### periodicPlate (quasistationary)

Quasistationary deformation of a periodic square plate under a static body
force, solved with the MRT scheme for stationary linear elasticity on a `D2Q8`
descriptor. The simulation is iterated until the displacement field stops
changing, and the converged result is compared against a manufactured solution.
Both lattice directions are periodic, so this case validates the collision
without any boundary condition.

The `run.sh` script sweeps the resolution from 30 to 120 and averages the
experimental order of convergence of displacement and stress into
`tmp/gnuplotData/data/eoc.csv`.
